text:
[{"word":"exciting","pronun":"[ɪkˈsaɪtɪŋ]","translation":"adj. 令人兴奋的；使人激动的
v. 激动；刺激（excite的ing形式）；唤起","audio":"exciting.mp3"},{"word":"fashionable","pronun":"[ˈfæʃnəbl]","translation":"adj. 流行的；时髦的；上流社会的","audio":"fashionable.mp3"},{"word":"funny","pronun":"[ˈfʌni]","translation":"n. 滑稽人物；笑话，有趣的故事；滑稽连环漫画栏；（英）（比赛用）单人双桨小艇
adj. 有趣的，好笑的，滑稽的；（口）稀奇的，古怪的，奇异的；有病的，不舒服的；狡猾的，欺骗（性）的，可疑的，不光明","audio":"funny.mp3"},{"word":"gentle","pronun":"[ˈdʒentl]","translation":"n. 蛆，饵
adj. 温和的；文雅的
vt. 使温和，使驯服","audio":"gentle.mp3"},{"word":"happy","pronun":"[ˈhæpi]","translation":"adj. 幸福的；高兴的；巧妙的","audio":"happy.mp3"},{"word":"honest","pronun":"[ˈɑːnɪst]","translation":"adj. 诚实的，实在的；可靠的；坦率的","audio":"honest.mp3"},{"word":"interested","pronun":"[ˈɪntrəstɪd; ˈɪntrestɪd]","translation":"v. 使…感兴趣（interest的过去分词）
adj. 感兴趣的；有权益的；有成见的","audio":"interested.mp3"},{"word":"interesting","pronun":"[ˈɪntrəstɪŋ; ˈɪntrestɪŋ]","translation":"adj. 有趣的；引起兴趣的，令人关注的","audio":"interesting.mp3"},{"word":"lazy","pronun":"[ˈleɪzi]","translation":"adj. 懒惰的；懒洋洋的；怠惰的；慢吞吞的","audio":"lazy.mp3"},{"word":"nervous","pronun":"[ˈnɜːrvəs]","translation":"adj. 神经的；紧张不安的；强健有力的","audio":"nervous.mp3"},{"word":"serious","pronun":"[ˈsɪriəs]","translation":"adj. 严肃的，严重的；认真的；庄重的；危急的","audio":"serious.mp3"},{"word":"shy","pronun":"[ʃaɪ]","translation":"n. 投掷；惊跳
adj. 害羞的；畏缩的，胆怯的
vi. 投；畏缩；惊退；厌恶
vt. 投；乱掷","audio":"shy.mp3"},{"word":"silly","pronun":"[ˈsɪli]","translation":"n. 傻瓜
adj. 愚蠢的；不明事理的；没头脑的","audio":"silly.mp3"},{"word":"stupid","pronun":"[ˈstuːpɪd]","translation":"n. 傻瓜，笨蛋
adj. 愚蠢的；麻木的；乏味的","audio":"stupid.mp3"},{"word":"tired","pronun":"[ˈtaɪərd]","translation":"v. 疲倦；对…腻烦（tire的过去分词形式）
adj. 疲倦的；厌倦的，厌烦的","audio":"tired.mp3"},{"word":"tiring","pronun":"[ˈtaɪərɪŋ]","translation":"adj. 累人的；麻烦的；无聊的；引起疲劳的
v. 厌倦；使劳累（tire的ing形式）；感到疲倦","audio":"tiring.mp3"},{"word":"upset","pronun":"[ˌʌpˈset]","translation":"n. 混乱；翻倒；颠覆
adj. 心烦的；混乱的；弄翻的
vt. 使心烦；颠覆；扰乱
vi. 翻倒","audio":"upset.mp3"},{"word":"bar","pronun":"[bɑːr]","translation":"n. 条，棒；酒吧；障碍；法庭
prep. 除……外
vt. 禁止；阻拦","audio":"bar.mp3"},{"word":"beautiful","pronun":"[ˈbjuːtɪf(ə)l]","translation":"adj. 美丽的
出色地
出色的
迷人的
迷人地","audio":"beautiful.mp3"},{"word":"bookshop","pronun":"[ˈbʊkʃɑːp]","translation":"n. 书店","audio":"bookshop.mp3"}]
